summary: Monitor an HAProxy load balancer by configuring its stats endpoint, installing Grafana Alloy, enabling the integration, and installing dashboards and alerts.

needs.description: HAProxy server >=1.6 with admin access to edit config (stats endpoint) and outbound HTTPS to *.grafana.net.
needs.evidence: Before you begin: An HAProxy server running version 1.6 or later

needs.description: Grafana Alloy installed on the HAProxy host with a Cloud access token, sending metrics to the stack.
HAProxy metrics (haproxy_* series) present in the stack Prometheus datasource for Explore verification.
HAProxy integration available in Connections catalog (dashboards/alerts installable).

reviewNotes: Could be simulated by synthetic haproxy_* metrics but Alloy install steps assume a real host.
